responsibility: Implements lightweight front-end quad optimization and reachability analysis. It scans quadruple ranges to fold redundant gotos and invertible branch-plus-goto patterns, traverses scope blocks to mark procedures reachable from calls, addresses, and parameter flows, propagates reachability across nested modules and exported procedures, and records procedure-priority side conditions, supplying the dead-procedure and branch cleanup used by `M2Code` before GCC tree emission.
same_name_distinction: Implementation module for the M2Optimize pair: it performs the concrete quad simplifications and marks reachable procedures across scopes, modules, calls, and address-taking operations, whereas `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2Optimize.def` only declares those optimization services.
